research.config_copier.name: Config Copier
research.config_copier.short: A tool that copies machine and conduit settings
research.config_copier.about: Big factories repeat the same settings dozens of times. The Config Copier reads the settings of a conduit face, a conduit bundle, an Auto Crafter or a Drawer and pastes them somewhere else.
research.machine_tier_1.name: Advanced Machines
research.machine_tier_1.short: A kit that upgrades a machine by one tier
research.machine_tier_1.about: Using an upgrade kit on a machine makes it work faster and in bigger batches. The kit is made from a control circuit, which is made from Infused Alloy and Reinforced Alloy. Alloys come from the Alloy Smelter.
research.machine_tier_2.name: Precision Machines
research.machine_tier_2.short: A kit that upgrades an advanced machine once more
research.machine_tier_2.about: The Precision Kit is built on the Advanced Kit and needs Control Circuit III, made from Atomic Alloy. Precision machines use a lot of energy per tick, so check the speed of your energy conduits.
research.machine_tier_3.name: Ultimate Machines
research.machine_tier_3.short: The final upgrade kit for machines
research.machine_tier_3.about: The Ultimate Kit is an expensive part that needs Netherite, Atomic Alloy, Circuit IV and essences. Ultimate machines are costly enough that you will only upgrade a few.
research.magic_sieve.name: Magic Sieve
research.magic_sieve.short: A sieve whose output changes with essence
research.magic_sieve.about: The Magic Sieve is an Auto Sieve with an essence slot. Insert a mob's essence and the sifting results change to that mob's theme. Drowned give ocean items, Piglins give Nether items, Endermen give End items, and essences of harder mobs make rare items more likely.

advancement.magic_sieve.hint:
Research and build a Magic Sieve
(Dimension Gate comes first)

research.laboratory.name: Laboratory
research.laboratory.short: A machine that makes research essences
research.laboratory.about: The Laboratory fills Glass Bottles with one era's materials to make research essences. Higher research asks for essences along with materials, so an essence line is how you prepare for the next research. Running one essence type per Laboratory is easiest.

research.alloy_smelter.about: The Alloy Smelter is an energy-powered machine that melts two materials together into an alloy. Bronze (3 copper + 1 tin -> 4), Electrum (gold + silver -> 2), Invar (2 iron + 1 nickel -> 3), Steel (1 iron + 4 coal -> 1).
research.alloy_smelter.name: Alloy Smelter
research.alloy_smelter.short: A machine that makes alloys from two materials
research.auto_miner.about: The Auto Miner mines the block directly below it and stacks the results in its output slot. Take them out with a hopper or conduit.
research.auto_miner.name: Auto Miner
research.auto_miner.short: Mines the block below on its own
research.auto_sieve.about: The Auto Sieve sifts the Gravel, Sand and Dust fed in by a hopper and sends the results to a chest beside or below it.
research.auto_sieve.name: Auto Sieve
research.auto_sieve.short: Sifts hopper-fed materials on its own
research.barrel.about: Barrels collect plant materials to make water. This is how you get water on a sky island. Putting Dust in a water-filled Barrel turns it into a Clay block. Start with the Oak Barrel.
research.barrel.name: Barrel
research.barrel.short: Collects plant materials to make water
research.chest.about: The chest is the basic storage that holds items and connects to hoppers, Drawers and machines.
research.chest.name: Chest
research.clay.about: Makes Clay blocks and Brick blocks.
research.clay.name: Clay
research.compost.about: The Composter collects plant materials and turns them into Dirt. This is how you grow your Dirt supply on a sky island.
research.compost.name: Composter
research.conduit_upgrade_2.about: Enhanced Conduits are faster than Basic Conduits (energy 48,000 RE/t, items 3.2 item/t, fluids 1000 mB/t).
research.conduit_upgrade_2.name: Enhanced Conduits
research.conduit_upgrade_3.about: Ender Conduits carry up to 192,000 RE/t of energy, 6.4 item/t of items and 8000 mB/t of fluids.
research.conduit_upgrade_3.name: Ender Conduits
research.copper.about: Make Copper Ore from 4 Copper Ore Chunks and smelt it into a Copper Ingot. Recipes for copper ingots, nuggets and blocks unlock too.
research.copper.name: Copper Processing
research.copper.short: Copper Ore Chunks into Copper Ingots
research.crucible.about: The Electric Crucible melts Cobblestone one at a time into 250 mB of Lava. It needs energy; feed Cobblestone with a hopper or conduit, and take Lava out with a fluid conduit or Bucket.
research.crucible.name: Electric Crucible
research.crucible.short: A machine that melts Cobblestone into Lava
research.crusher.about: The Crusher does the Hammer's crushing on its own: Stone -> Cobblestone -> Gravel -> Sand -> Dust. Ore gives 3 raw ore, plus a half chance of 2 more.
research.crusher.name: Crusher
research.diamond_tools.about: A Diamond Pickaxe can mine Obsidian, and a Diamond Sword deals the most damage in mob waves. Diamonds come from sifting Gravel with a Diamond Mesh.
research.diamond_tools.name: Diamond Tools
research.dimension_gate.about: Right-click the Dimension Gate to start a mob wave. Defeat every mob within the time limit to unlock the next level, and get essence on your first clear. Mobs drop their own loot and sometimes essence.
research.dimension_gate.name: Dimension Gate
research.dimension_gate.short: A gate that opens mob waves
research.drawer.about: A Drawer stores a huge amount of a single item type. Lock the type with a Drawer Lock Key.
research.drawer.name: Drawer
research.drawer.short: Stores a huge amount of one item type
research.drawer_upgrades.about: Increase a Drawer's capacity, or void excess items when it is full so your line never clogs.
research.drawer_upgrades.name: Drawer Upgrades
research.energy_cell.about: The Energy Cell takes energy from conduits or adjacent machines, stores up to 100,000 RE and sends it out where needed.
research.energy_cell.name: Energy Cell
research.energy_conduit.about: Energy Conduits connect on their own to nearby conduits, generators and machines to carry energy. Basic Conduits carry up to 8,000 RE/t.
research.energy_conduit.name: Energy Conduit
research.energy_conduit.short: Basic conduit that carries energy far
research.farming.about: Bake bread from Wheat and make Hay Bales. Farming starts here.
research.farming.name: Farming
research.farming.short: Bread and Hay Bales. Farming starts here
research.fluid_tank.about: The Fluid Tank holds up to 16000 mB of water and lava. Fill and empty it with Buckets; fluid conduits exchange fluids with nearby barrels, crucibles and generators.
research.fluid_tank.name: Fluid Tank
research.furnace.about: The Furnace cooks and smelts: Cobblestone -> Stone, Sand -> Glass, Logs -> Charcoal, iron chunks and more. It makes materials for many research projects.
research.furnace.name: Furnace
research.fluid_conduit.about: Fluid Conduits are pipes that connect to nearby conduits and carry fluids. Basic Conduits carry up to 200 mB per tick.
research.fluid_conduit.name: Fluid Conduit
research.fluid_conduit.short: Basic conduit that carries fluids far
research.generator.about: The Combustion Generator burns fuel such as Coal, Charcoal and Planks to make energy. Machines run on this energy.
research.generator.name: Combustion Generator
research.glasswork.about: Makes Glass Panes and Glass Bottles.
research.glasswork.name: Glasswork
research.gold.about: Make Gold Ore from 4 Gold Ore Chunks and smelt it into a Gold Ingot.
research.gold.name: Gold Processing
research.gold.short: Gold Ore Chunks into Gold Ingots
research.hammer.about: Breaking stone with a Stone Hammer crushes it one step finer: Cobblestone -> Gravel -> Sand -> Dust. It is the key tool for making resources on a sky island.
research.hammer.name: Stone Hammer
research.harvest.about: Makes melon and pumpkin foods and seeds.
research.harvest.name: Harvest
research.harvest.short: Melon and pumpkin foods and seeds
research.harvester.about: The Auto Crop Harvester harvests grown crops and fully bloomed magic flowers in a 9x9 area at its own height.
research.harvester.name: Auto Crop Harvester
research.hopper.about: Hoppers move items from above or the side into machines or chests. Automation starts here.
research.hopper.name: Hopper
research.iron.about: Make Iron Ore from 4 Iron Ore Chunks and smelt it in a Furnace into an Iron Ingot. It is the basis for hoppers, machines and iron tools.
research.iron.name: Iron Processing
research.iron.short: Processes Iron Ore Chunks into Iron Ingots
research.iron_tools.about: Makes iron pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes and swords. An Iron Pickaxe mines harder blocks. Buckets and Shears are separate research.
research.iron_tools.name: Iron Tools
research.iron_tools.short: Iron pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword
research.iron_hammer.about: Mining while sneaking with the Iron Hammer breaks up to 256 connected blocks of the same type at once. Each block costs a little durability and hunger, and a full hunger bar breaks 256 blocks. Sneak and look at a block to see the blocks that will break in light blue. Stone and Cobblestone break too, so lay slab floors where you use the Iron Hammer.
research.iron_hammer.name: Iron Hammer
research.iron_hammer.short: A hammer that breaks connected blocks at once
research.item_conduit.about: Item Conduits connect on their own to nearby chests, Drawers, machines and furnaces and carry items from the extracting side to the inserting side. Right-click a conduit to set extract, insert and the channel of each side in its settings window.
research.item_conduit.name: Item Conduit
research.item_conduit.short: Basic conduit that carries items far
research.kelp.name: Kelp
research.lava_generator.about: The Lava Generator burns lava from its tank to make 80 RE/t. Link an Electric Crucible's lava with fluid conduits and you have a factory that turns Cobblestone into energy.
research.lava_generator.name: Lava Generator
research.lava_generator.short: A generator that burns lava for energy
research.lead.about: Lead Ore Chunks are sifted from Gravel and Crushed Deepslate, and 4 chunks make Lead Ore. Lead goes into Invar and machine parts.
research.lead.name: Lead
research.magic_botany.about: Plant the magic flower seeds that Dimension Gate mobs sometimes drop on Dirt or Grass to grow a magic flower of that color (there are seeds for all sixteen colors), which gives petals. Craft Ore Bloom Seeds from petals, vanilla flowers and metal dust to grow flowers that yield Ore Chunks.
research.magic_botany.name: Magic Plants
research.magic_essence.about: Add mob essence and petals to a Redstone Gem Bloom Seed to make an Essence Bloom Seed. An Essence Bloom grows one mob essence at a time.
research.magic_essence.name: Essence Bloom
research.magic_essence.short: A flower that grows mob essence
research.magic_gems.about: Add vanilla crops, petals and gem materials to an Ore Bloom Seed to craft Lapis, Redstone, Quartz, Coal, Diamond and Emerald Gem Bloom Seeds.
research.magic_gems.name: Gem Bloom
research.magic_gems.short: Flowers that grow gems and Redstone
research.masonry.about: Stone building parts such as cobblestone and stone stairs, slabs, walls and Stone Bricks.
research.masonry.name: Masonry
research.masonry.short: Stone stairs, slabs, bricks and other building parts
research.mesh_diamond.about: The Diamond Mesh sifts out more, and rarer, items than the Gold Mesh. Netherite Scrap appears very rarely too.
research.mesh_diamond.name: Diamond Mesh
research.mesh_diamond.short: A Mesh that sifts out diamonds
research.mesh_netherite.about: The Netherite Mesh sifts out the most. It also unlocks the recipe for Netherite Ingots from Netherite Scrap and gold.
research.mesh_netherite.name: Netherite Mesh
research.mesh_netherite.short: The finest Mesh, plus Netherite Ingots
research.mob_simulator.about: There are no mobs on the island, so put mob essence (sifted from Dust with an Iron Mesh or better) into the simulator: each essence produces that mob's drops eight times. Enderman (Ender Pearl) and Blaze (Blaze Rod) essences only come from better Meshes.
research.mob_simulator.name: Mob Simulator
research.mob_simulator.short: A machine that makes mob drops from essence
research.nickel.about: Nickel Ore Chunks are sifted from Gravel and Crushed Deepslate, and 4 chunks make Nickel Ore. Mix it with iron to make Invar.
research.nickel.name: Nickel
research.ore_washer.about: The Ore Washer washes raw ore with water into 2 dusts. Each raw ore uses 250 mB of water; fill it with Buckets or fluid conduits. Washing the raw ore the Crusher breaks out of ore turns one ore into about 8 ingots.
research.ore_washer.name: Ore Washer
research.ore_washer.short: A machine that triples your dust
research.pebbles.about: Combine 4 Pebbles into a stone block such as Cobblestone. This is the first way to get stone on a sky island with no stone yet.
research.pebbles.name: Stone Packing
research.pebbles.short: Makes a stone block from 4 Pebbles
research.sieve.about: The Sieve sifts Gravel, Sand, Dirt and Dust for resources such as Ore Chunks and seeds. Most sky island resources come from here. The Sieve's Mesh is crafted separately and inserted (String Mesh: 9 String in a 3x3).
research.sieve.name: Sieve
research.sieve.short: Sifts Gravel and Sand for resources
research.silver.about: Silver Ore Chunks are sifted from Gravel and Crushed Deepslate (often with a Gold Mesh), and 4 chunks make Silver Ore. Mix it with gold to make Electrum.
research.silver.name: Silver
research.slab.about: Oak Slabs are a material for building and many recipes. You need them before you can make a Composter.
research.slab.name: Oak Slab
research.slab.short: A slab for building and Composters
research.stick.about: Sticks go into almost every tool and machine. All research starts here.
research.stick.name: Stick
research.stick.short: Material for every tool and machine. Research starts here
research.stone_barrel.about: Put 8 Cobblestone in a Stone Barrel with a heat source below and it melts them into a bucket of Lava. With water and lava you can build a cobblestone generator.
research.stone_barrel.name: Stone Barrel
research.stone_barrel.short: A barrel that melts Cobblestone into Lava
research.stone_tools.about: Stone pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword. Stripping logs with a stone or better axe also gives Bark Fiber.
research.stone_tools.name: Stone Tools
research.storage_controller.about: The Storage Controller treats connected Drawers within 16 blocks as one storage. Hoppers and conduits attached to the controller insert into and extract from the right Drawer, and right-clicking opens the full list. Storage Links connect distant Drawers without storing anything themselves.
research.storage_controller.name: Storage Controller
research.string.about: String is the material for Sieve Meshes. Place 3 fibers in a row on a crafting table to get 3 String.
research.string.name: String
research.tin.about: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal. Tin Ore Chunks are sifted from Gravel and Crushed Deepslate, and 4 chunks make Tin Ore. Tin goes into Bronze.
research.tin.name: Tin
research.tinker_table.about: At the Tinker Table, choose a metal head and handle to make swords, pickaxes, axes and shovels. Tools gain experience and level up as you kill mobs or mine blocks, and each level adds a modifier slot for Sharpness, Haste, Durability, Fire, Looting or Lifesteal.
research.tinker_table.name: Tinker Table
research.tinker_table.short: A workbench for making and upgrading tools
research.torch.name: Torch
research.wood_hopper.about: The Wooden Hopper has only one slot and is very slow, but it moves items without iron. It is the first step toward early bulk work. The Wooden Reverse Hopper, a flipped Wooden Hopper, unlocks too.
research.wood_hopper.name: Wooden Hopper
research.wood_hopper.short: Slow, but moves items without iron
research.wood_tools.about: Wooden pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword. They dig and till faster than bare hands.
research.wood_tools.name: Wooden Tools
research.wood_tools.short: Wooden pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword
research.woodwork.about: Building parts such as oak slabs, stairs, fences, doors, ladders and bowls.
research.woodwork.name: Woodwork
research.woodwork.short: Slabs, stairs, fences and other building parts
research.wooden_bucket.name: Wooden Bucket
research.wooden_bucket.short: A wooden pail that holds only water
research.wooden_bucket.about: A bucket made of planks. It scoops and pours water only (no lava). You can carry water from Barrels before you have an iron Bucket.
research.bucket.name: Bucket
research.bucket.short: A pail that carries water and lava
research.bucket.about: Scoop water from Barrels or lava from Stone Barrels with a Bucket and pour it into tanks. Water and lava are essential for most machines on this island.
research.shears.name: Shears
research.shears.short: A tool that collects leaves as they are
research.shears.about: Mining leaves with Shears drops the leaf block itself. Handy for gathering Composter and Barrel materials.
research.copper_tools.name: Copper Tools
research.copper_tools.short: Copper pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword
research.copper_tools.about: Makes a full set of copper tools. Harder than stone and cheaper than iron, they are good when iron runs short.
research.copper_armor.name: Copper Armor
research.copper_armor.short: Copper helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots
research.copper_armor.about: Makes a full set of copper armor. Good for not going bare before starting mob waves.
research.iron_armor.name: Iron Armor
research.iron_armor.short: Iron helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots
research.iron_armor.about: Makes a full set of iron armor. Once waves get hard, surviving without armor is tough.
research.gold_tools.name: Gold Tools
research.gold_tools.short: Golden pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword
research.gold_tools.about: Makes a full set of golden tools. They are weak, but worth making when you have Gold Ingots to spare.
research.gold_armor.name: Gold Armor
research.gold_armor.short: Golden helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots
research.gold_armor.about: Makes a full set of golden armor. Low protection, but it shines.
research.diamond_armor.name: Diamond Armor
research.diamond_armor.about: Makes a full set of diamond armor. You need it to face elite waves.
research.archery.name: Bow
research.archery.short: A bow for hitting distant mobs
research.archery.about: Makes a Bow. With arrows dropped by Skeletons, you can hit wave mobs from afar.
research.ironwork.name: Ironwork
research.ironwork.short: Iron Bars, Chains, Lanterns and Flint and Steel
research.ironwork.about: Makes small building parts from iron. Make windows with Iron Bars, light the island with Lanterns, and start fires with Flint and Steel.
research.workbenches.name: Workstations
research.workbenches.short: Stonecutter, Grindstone, Fletching Table, Loom and Smithing Table
research.workbenches.about: Unlocks five village workstations at once. The Stonecutter speeds up stone building.
research.anvil.name: Anvil
research.anvil.short: An anvil for repairing and combining tools
research.anvil.about: Repair or rename tools with an Anvil. It takes a lot of iron, so plan ahead.
research.smelters.name: Special Furnaces
research.smelters.about: Machines adapted from the Furnace. The Blast Furnace smelts ore and the Smoker cooks food twice as fast.
research.redstone_work.name: Redstone Crafting
research.redstone_work.short: Lever, Redstone Torch and Block of Redstone
research.redstone_work.about: Makes simple redstone devices. Toggle things with a Lever, and store Redstone Dust compactly as a Block of Redstone.
research.compression.name: Gem Compression
research.compression.short: Coal, Lapis, Emerald and Diamond blocks
research.compression.about: Compresses minerals into blocks and back again. Minerals piling up in Drawers take less space.
research.quartz_work.name: Quartz Crafting
research.quartz_work.about: Makes fine white building blocks from Nether Quartz.
research.sandstone.name: Sandstone
research.sandstone.about: Hardens Sand into solid Sandstone. Good for island floors and walls.
research.crystals.name: Crystal Crafting
research.crystals.short: Block of Amethyst and Tinted Glass
research.crystals.about: Makes crystal blocks and dark glass from Amethyst Shards.
research.navigation.name: Navigation Tools
research.navigation.about: Tools that keep you from getting lost as your island grows.
research.golden_food.name: Golden Food
research.golden_food.short: Golden Apple, Golden Carrot and Glistering Melon Slice
research.golden_food.about: Makes food with gold. One bite restores a lot of health.
research.bone_craft.name: Bone Crafting
research.bone_craft.about: Turns bones dropped by Skeletons into meal and blocks. Bone Meal makes crops grow faster.
research.slime_block.name: Slime Block
research.slime_block.about: Packs Slimeballs into a single block. Step on it to bounce up.
research.blaze_craft.name: Blaze Crafting
research.blaze_craft.short: Blaze Powder, Magma Cream and Eye of Ender
research.blaze_craft.about: Grinds Blaze Rods into powder and unlocks its uses. The Fire modifier for tools and Essence Blooms use this powder too.
research.ender_chest.name: Ender Chest
research.ender_chest.short: A chest with the same contents everywhere
research.ender_chest.about: An Ender Chest's contents belong to the player, so every Ender Chest you open holds the same items. Good for moving goods between islands.
research.dyeing.name: Dyeing
research.dyeing.short: Dyes and colored blocks from petals
research.dyeing.about: Grind petals into dyes in sixteen colors, and use them to color glass, terracotta, concrete powder and candles.

research.electric_furnace.name: Electric Furnace
research.electric_furnace.short: A machine that cooks without fuel
research.electric_furnace.about: The Electric Furnace uses energy to cook anything a Furnace can (ore dust, logs, food, sand and more). It is twice as fast as a Furnace needs no fuel and gives no experience.
research.item_vacuum.name: Item Vacuum
research.item_vacuum.short: A machine that collects dropped items
research.item_vacuum.about: The Item Vacuum collects items dropped around it (6 blocks across, 3 below, 5 above) into its output slot. Use it to gather Tree Feller saplings, sieve byproducts and mob drops in one place.
research.tree_feller.name: Tree Feller
research.tree_feller.short: A machine that cuts and plants trees on its own
research.tree_feller.about: The Tree Feller cuts nearby logs one at a time, highest first. When there are no logs to cut, it plants saplings from its input slot on Dirt to regrow trees. It leaves leaves alone to decay on their own.
research.auto_crafter.name: Auto Crafter
research.auto_crafter.short: A machine that crafts for you
research.auto_crafter.about: The Auto Crafter keeps crafting one set recipe as materials arrive. Only recipes unlocked by research can be set, and crafting table recipes need only the materials, whatever the shape.

research.project_industry.name: Industry Project
research.project_industry.short: A large project that fills a metal warehouse
research.project_industry.about: Once your factory is up and running, the next goal is to stockpile alloys in bulk. It is one of three projects leading to the Dragon Egg; this research unlocks no recipes, and offering the materials is the goal itself.
research.project_hunter.name: Hunter Project
research.project_hunter.short: A project of offering wave loot
research.project_hunter.about: A project for hunters made strong by the Dimension Gate and their gear. Offer loot from the Mob Simulator and waves.
research.project_botanist.name: Botanist Project
research.project_botanist.short: A project of offering the rarest seeds and essences
research.project_botanist.about: The project for botanists who have grown magic plants to the end. Offer the highest grade flower seeds and essences.
research.project_dragon.name: Dragon Egg
research.project_dragon.about: The final project, open only to islands that have finished the three projects. Offer all the materials to unlock the Dragon Egg recipe, then place the egg on your island to complete DragonFactory.
